title: Cognition Launches Devin Security 2.0 With Hundreds of Millions in Credits
summary:
Cognition's new autonomous security platform identifies and remediates software flaws to help defense teams close security loops at machine pace. To support the rollout of the Devin Security 2.0 tool, the company is providing hundreds of millions of dollars in credits for enterprise customers to conduct deep scans and for new customers to perform remediation on the vulnerabilities they find.

The platform is powered by Claude Mythos and other frontier cyber models to scan, prioritize, and fix urgent vulnerabilities. Cognition described the service as an "autonomous defense factory" designed to address what it called a "new dark age of cybersecurity."
